description: Smoke test of the campus-customs MCP server (mcp_server/server.py) through Claude Code's MCP connection configured in the project-root .mcp.json. Each output below is the exact JSON returned by a real MCP tool call, then checked against data/campus_customs_new.db.

tests.prompt: Using the campus-customs MCP server, check whether we have 20 navy hoodies (SKU CC-HOOD-NAVY) in size M in stock for the Yale AI Club, and show the unit cost, list price, and margin.
tests.database_check: inventory row (CC-HOOD-NAVY, M): name 'Basic Hoodie Big Yale', qty 8, location 'Aisle A'; pricing row CC-HOOD-NAVY: unit_cost 22.0, list_price 58.0. Derived values check out: shortfall 20-8=12, margin 58-22=36, 36/58=62.1%.

tests.prompt: Using the campus-customs MCP server, look up invoice 501 for the Bulldog tee restock: is it overdue, and which vendor is it from?
tests.database_check: invoices row 501: vendor_id 1, amount 840.0, due_date 2026-08-28, status 'open', description 'Rush reprint CC-TEE-WHITE S'; vendors row 1: 'Bulldog Print Co', 'apparel reprint', lead_days 5; invoice 501 is vendor 1's only invoice; desk.date_today 2026-08-31, so it is 3 days past due.

tests.prompt: Using the campus-customs MCP server, check the rent for lease 1: how much is due, when is it due, and can our cash cover it?
tests.database_check: leases row 1: 'Chapel Street shop', 'Elm City Properties', monthly_rent 2400.0, next_due 2026-09-02, notes empty; cash_accounts: checking 3400.0 dated 2026-08-31 (only account); desk.date_today 2026-08-31, so 2 days until due and 3400-2400=1000 left.

database_unchanged.note: The server opens the database read-only (sqlite mode=ro), so the tools cannot write. The file's SHA-1 was identical when checked right after the MCP calls and again after this evidence file was written; the file's modified time (Oct 11 11:03) is earlier than these tests.
